title: FlyDubai Passenger Who Helped Subdue Pilot Describes Stabbing Attack in Cockpit
summary_full: A passenger on a flight to Tel Aviv on Wednesday said he watched in horror as the plane’s pilots tumbled out of the cockpit, locked in a bloody brawl.
